mapper.update: /*saveMasterMdCtNewCustomerRfq*/ INSERT INTO KEP_CUSTOMER_RFQ ( BUYER , REVISION , STATUS , PROCESS_TYPE , ADD_USER_ID , ADD_DATE , CHANGE_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{cmpyNo} , '1' , 'C' , 'GA' , #{USER_ID} , SYSDATE , #{USER_ID} , SYSDATE )

/*saveMasterMdCtNewCustomerkepVisit*/ INSERT INTO KEP_VISITHD ( BUYER , STATUS , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_USER_ID , POTENTIAL_CUSTOMER_YN ) VALUES ( #{cmpyNo} , 'C' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , #{USER_ID} , #{USER_ID} , 'Y' )
mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCtNewCustomerDt*/ SELECT A.BUYER ,A.BUYER_NAME ,A.GROUP_NAME ,A.STATUS ,A.SALES_YEAR ,A.SALES_AMT ,A.CREDIT_DATE ,A.CREDIT_RATING ,A.IRS_NO ,A.CEO_NAME_LOC ,A.INDUSTRY_TYPE ,A.BUSINESS_ITEMS ,A.MAJOR_ITEM ,A.EMPLOYEE_YEAR ,A.EMPLOYEE_CNT ,A.HEAD_ADDRESS_LOC ,A.FACTORY_ADDRESS_LOC ,A.KEP_USER_DEPT ,(SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'C001' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.CODE = A.KEP_USER_DEPT) AS KEP_USER_DEPT_NM ,A.KEP_USER_ID ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NM ,A.BUSINESS_METHOD ,A.MRO_YN ,A.MRO_COMPANY ,A.MRO_START ,A.MRO_END ,A.PAST_MRO_YN ,A.PAST_MRO_COMPANY ,A.PAST_MRO_START ,A.PAST_MRO_END ,A.MRO_YEAR_AMT ,A.BILL_TYPE ,A.SYSTEM_TYPE ,A.MRO_SPEND ,A.KEYMAN_DEPT_NAME1 ,A.KEYMAN_USER_NAME1 ,A.KEYMAN_TEL_NAME1 ,A.KEYMAN_DEPT_NAME2 ,A.KEYMAN_USER_NAME2 ,A.KEYMAN_TEL_NAME2 ,A.KEYMAN_DEPT_NAME3 ,A.KEYMAN_USER_NAME3 ,A.KEYMAN_TEL_NAME3 ,A.INTEREST_STATUS ,A.INTEREST_USER ,A.INTEREST_MAIN ,A.ADD_USER_ID ,A.ADD_DATE ,A.CHANGE_USER_ID ,A.CHANGE_DATE ,A.BUYER_CLOSE_FLAG ,A.BUYER_CLOSE_REMARK ,B.PROCESS_TYPE ,B.REVISION ,A.TEL_NO ,A.GROUP_CO_NM ,A.INDUSTRY_NM ,(SELECT DECODE(COUNT(MST.IRS_NO),0,'N','Y') FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO = A.IRS_NO) AS MST_YN FROM KEP_CUSTOMER A, KEP_CUSTOMER_RFQ B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.BUYER = #{com_code}
mapper.update: /*saveMasterMdCtNewCustomerRfqAdd*/ INSERT INTO KEP_CUSTOMER_RFQ ( BUYER , REVISION , STATUS , PROCESS_TYPE , ADD_USER_ID , ADD_DATE , CHANGE_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{st_com_code} , NVL((SELECT MAX(A.REVISION) FROM KEP_CUSTOMER_RFQ A WHERE A.BUYER =#{st_com_code}),0)+1 , 'C' , 'GA' , #{USER_ID} , SYSDATE , #{USER_ID} , SYSDATE )

/*updateMasterMdCtMSTNewCustomer*/ UPDATE KEP_CUSTOMER A SET BUYER_NAME = NVL((SELECT MST.COM_NAME_LOC FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.BUYER_NAME) , GROUP_NAME = NVL((SELECT MST.CONGLOMERATE FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.GROUP_NAME) , STATUS = 'R' , SALES_YEAR = NVL((SELECT MST.YYYY FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.SALES_YEAR) , SALES_AMT = NVL((SELECT MST.YEAR_AMT FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.SALES_AMT) , CREDIT_DATE = NVL((SELECT MST.YYYY FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.CREDIT_DATE) , CREDIT_RATING = NVL((SELECT MST.CREDIT_RATING FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.CREDIT_RATING) , CEO_NAME_LOC = NVL((SELECT MST.CEO_NAME_LOC FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.CEO_NAME_LOC) , INDUSTRY_TYPE = NVL((SELECT MST.INDUSTRY_CODE FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.INDUSTRY_TYPE) , EMPLOYEE_YEAR = NVL((SELECT MST.YYYY FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.EMPLOYEE_YEAR) , EMPLOYEE_CNT = NVL((SELECT MST.EMP_CNT FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.EMPLOYEE_CNT) , HEAD_ADDRESS_LOC = NVL((SELECT MST.ADDRESS_LOC FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.HEAD_ADDRESS_LOC) , TEL_NO = NVL((SELECT MST.TEL_NO FROM KEP.KEP_CUSTOMER_MST MST WHERE MST.IRS_NO =A.IRS_NO), A.TEL_NO) , CHANGE_USER_ID =#{USER_ID} , CHANGE_DATE =SYSDATE WHERE BUYER =#{st_com_code}
